description: Read recent Outlook Sent Items through the bundled read-only PowerShell COM script to find waiting-for candidates.

onboarding.question: Do you want close-day to scan sent mail for waiting-for follow-ups?
setup_questions: Which sent-mail source should close-day use?
If Outlook is selected, is desktop Outlook installed and signed in?
connector_probes: Run scripts/Get-OutlookSentItems.ps1 with a dry-run output file.
